minimum_questions.body: Which detailed design, interfaces and tradeoffs does the owner choose?
minimum_questions.why_required: Implementation needs an explicit design and comparison of meaningful alternatives.

minimum_questions.body: Which project style, module and component rules govern this change?
minimum_questions.why_required: Local standards and real component contracts must be established before implementation.

minimum_questions.body: Which objective checks, inputs, oracle and failure or unknown conditions establish acceptance?
minimum_questions.why_required: A claimed result must be testable within the valid configuration and resource limits.

minimum_questions.body: Which goals, non-goals and scope does the owner accept?
minimum_questions.why_required: Product direction cannot be inferred from silence or an agent summary.

minimum_questions.body: Which slices, dependencies and shared-file owners determine the implementation order?
minimum_questions.why_required: Each slice needs independently observable behavior and explicit prerequisites.

minimum_questions.body: Which company documents, meeting decisions or implicit constraints are necessary, and what information is missing?
minimum_questions.why_required: General knowledge cannot replace necessary project-specific evidence or an explicit owner exception.
